meta.title: Digitaldoc — Folders, documents, and share links
meta.description: Digitaldoc: organize documents, upload and merge PDFs for free, edit content, and share with a link. Includes 1 GB of free storage.

a11y.heroImage: Screenshot of the Digitaldoc app: documents list with folders and sharing

hero.title: Folders, documents, and simple sharing
hero.lead: Organize contracts and files in folders, upload and merge PDFs for free, edit rich content, and share documents with a link — all in one app.

features.title: Everything you need, without the clutter
features.subtitle: Features available in the platform today — built for teams that work with documents every day.

folders.title: Nested folders
folders.desc: Structure documents in folder trees — nest by client, case, or project and keep everything easy to find.

editor.title: Document editor
editor.desc: Visual editor: formatted text, tables, images, customizable templates, and advanced mode for full pages.

pdf.title: Free PDF uploads and merging
pdf.desc: Upload, view, and download PDFs for free. Combine files in your chosen order into a new PDF while keeping the originals. Files use your storage, with 1 GB included free.

sharing.title: Share with a link
sharing.desc: Publish a file or folder, copy the share link, and send it. Recipients open it in the browser — no account required.

auth.title: Secure authentication
auth.desc: Local account with password or Google sign-in. Secure sessions and password reset by email.

i18n.title: Romanian and English
i18n.desc: The interface adapts to your language. API messages respect your locale preference.

how.title: How it works
how.subtitle: Three steps from a new account to a shared document.

step1.title: Create your structure
step1.desc: Add folders and documents. Each document can contain simple content or a full styled page.

step2.title: Edit content
step2.desc: Use the visual editor or advanced mode. Insert fields and variables for dynamic text in PDF export.

step3.title: Share and preview
step3.desc: Preview the PDF, copy a share link, and send it — recipients open the document without signing up.

forWhom.title: Who is Digitaldoc for?
forWhom.subtitle: From schools and professional offices to teams that need a clear home for documents.

schools.title: Schools and institutions
schools.desc: Student lists, contracts, and official documents organized by class and school year — easy to update and export to PDF.

legal.title: Notary and legal offices
legal.desc: Contracts, annexes, and deeds grouped by client or case file. Share a link when someone needs access.

photographers.title: Photographers
photographers.desc: Keep contracts, briefs, and deliverables per client or event. Share a link with the client and verify the PDF before delivery.

teams.title: Teams and professionals
teams.desc: One place for documents you can share with a link — no more folders lost in email or on USB drives.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Start free, then check only the fields and modules you need. Each purchase is its own monthly subscription, and you can add more features anytime.
pricing.vatNote: Prices shown are final. We are not registered for VAT.

core.title: Account & documents
core.description: Account access, document organization and sharing.

fields.title: Document fields
fields.description: Each field type is billed separately. Image picker is part of DigiStorage.

digiStorage.title: DigiStorage
digiStorage.description: Cloud storage integration, including the Image picker field.

assets.title: Assets
assets.description: Upload images, view them in your document tree and reuse them in templates.

pdf.title: PDF
pdf.description: PDF upload, viewing, download and merging are free within your storage quota, along with the HTML editor and document PDF download. Generated document PDF preview and the visual template editor are paid.

misc.title: Misc
misc.description: Data sources, .ddoc import & export, and field import & linking.

medicalFiles.title: DICOM & STL
medicalFiles.description: Upload medical imaging (.dcm) and 3D models (.stl) into your documents and view them in the app. Files use your storage.

storage.title: Storage
storage.description: Documents, uploaded and merged PDFs, DICOM & STL files and static assets share your storage. Every account has 1 GB free; your biggest tier counts.

contexto.title: Contexto
contexto.description: WhatsApp group assistant using the AI provider chosen in Settings. AI token usage is billed separately from the subscription.

documentScan.title: Document scanning
documentScan.description: Scan a document image and save the extracted text as a new document. Digitaldoc does not store the image. On top of the monthly subscription, you pay for the tokens you use, whether on DigitaldocAI infrastructure or with an external model.

documentEditWithAi.title: Document editing with AI
documentEditWithAi.description: AI Chat edits your document templates with the provider chosen in Settings. AI token usage is billed separately from the subscription.

aiChat.title: AI Chat
aiChat.description: An assistant on its own page that answers your questions about Digitaldoc, with the provider chosen in Settings. Free to use: AI tokens are paid with prepaid credits or by your own provider account.

documents.title: Files & folders
documents.desc: Create documents and organize them in folders.

guestShare.title: Guest sharing
guestShare.desc: Share published documents and folders using a link and PIN.

authentication.title: Account & sign-in
authentication.desc: Create an account and sign in with Google or a password.

digiStorage.title: DigiStorage + Image picker
digiStorage.desc: Connect DigiStorage folders and use Image picker on documents.

assets.title: Static assets
assets.desc: Upload JPEG, PNG or GIF images, view and download them, and reuse stored images in templates. Files use your storage quota.

htmlEditor.title: HTML Editor (v1)
htmlEditor.desc: Edit templates directly as HTML code.

pdfDownload.title: PDF download
pdfDownload.desc: Download documents as PDF, including from share links.

pdfEditor.title: Generated PDF preview & template editor
pdfEditor.desc: Preview PDFs generated from document templates and edit templates visually (v2). Uploaded PDF previews are free.

misc.title: Misc features
misc.desc: Reuse values from data sources, import and export .ddoc files, and import & link fields between documents.

medicalFiles.title: DICOM & STL files
medicalFiles.desc: Upload .dcm and .stl files and open them in the built-in 2D / 3D viewer.

contexto.title: Contexto
contexto.desc: Replies, summaries and custom skills for WhatsApp groups. Use DigitaldocAI with prepaid credits or your own OpenAI key, as chosen in Settings. AI token usage costs extra: DigitaldocAI uses credits; OpenAI bills your provider account.

documentScan.title: Document scanning
documentScan.desc: Scan a document image with the AI provider chosen in Settings and save the extracted text as a new document. DigitaldocAI: 100 RON / 1,000,000 tokens (input + output), from prepaid credits. External model (your own OpenAI key): the provider's rates, billed directly by the provider.

documentEditWithAi.title: Document editing with AI
documentEditWithAi.desc: AI Chat in the document preview creates and edits templates using DigitaldocAI or your own OpenAI key. AI token usage costs extra: DigitaldocAI uses prepaid credits; OpenAI bills your provider account.

aiChat.title: AI Chat
aiChat.desc: Ask how Digitaldoc works on a dedicated chat page, with the AI provider chosen in Settings. No subscription needed. DigitaldocAI uses prepaid credits; with your own OpenAI key, OpenAI bills your provider account. It only answers questions about Digitaldoc and cannot see your documents or account.

pdfFiles.title: PDF uploads & merging
pdfFiles.desc: Upload one PDF at a time, use its Preview tab and download or merge PDFs. Merge 2–100 PDFs, up to 100 MB and 5,000 pages in total. No subscription or AI credits required. Original files and merged copies use your storage quota.

TEXT.title: Text
TEXT.desc: Single-line text for names, titles, and short answers.

TEXTAREA.title: Text area
TEXTAREA.desc: Multi-line text for notes, comments, and longer content.

DIVIDER.title: Divider
DIVIDER.desc: Visual separator between sections in the form.

EMAIL.title: Email
EMAIL.desc: Email address with basic format validation.

PHONE.title: Phone
PHONE.desc: Phone number field for contact details.

PASSWORD.title: Password
PASSWORD.desc: Masked input for secrets or access codes.

NUMBER.title: Number
NUMBER.desc: Numeric values with optional min/max constraints.

DATE.title: Date
DATE.desc: Date picker for deadlines, birthdays, and schedules.

TITLE.title: Title
TITLE.desc: Section heading shown on the form (display only).

DISCLAIMER.title: Disclaimer
DISCLAIMER.desc: Legal or info notice shown on the form (display only).

PICKER.title: Picker
PICKER.desc: Dropdown to choose one option from a list.

CHECKBOX.title: Checkbox
CHECKBOX.desc: One or more on/off options the user can tick.

RADIO.title: Radio
RADIO.desc: Choose exactly one option from a set.

INFINITE_LIST.title: Infinite list
INFINITE_LIST.desc: Repeatable rows (tables) with nested child fields.

MAP.title: Map
MAP.desc: Place a pin on a map to capture a location.

SIGNATURE.title: Signature
SIGNATURE.desc: Draw or capture a handwritten signature.

PRODUCTS.title: Products
PRODUCTS.desc: Line items with product details for quotes and orders.

TABLE_INPUT.title: Table input
TABLE_INPUT.desc: A table with columns you define; people filling the document add rows.

tier5.title: 5 GB of storage
tier5.desc: Store up to 5 GB of documents, uploaded and merged PDFs, DICOM & STL files and images.

tier10.title: 10 GB of storage
tier10.desc: Store up to 10 GB of documents, uploaded and merged PDFs, DICOM & STL files and images.

tier20.title: 20 GB of storage
tier20.desc: Store up to 20 GB of documents, uploaded and merged PDFs, DICOM & STL files and images.

cta.title: Ready to organize your documents?
cta.subtitle: Open the app, create your first folder, and share a link in minutes.

contact.title: Contact
contact.subtitle: Questions about a demo, pricing, or partnership? Write to us.
